people.imagined: Midday on the casting floor of the mountain pavilion. She has just thrown back her head and laughed at a joke from a caster, loud enough to carry. The three blue jade pendants swing at her throat and click against each other. Her forearms are bare and shining with old burn scars. Behind the laugh her eyes are tired.
people.subject: The moment: at noon on a casting floor she has thrown her head back in a loud laugh, mouth open, caught mid-sound, one hand raised as if to slap a shoulder. Face: most important, three blue jade pendants on one cord hang at her throat against the collar, glowing deep lapis blue and clearly visible, and her forearms show pale shiny burn scars. A broad, stout face with full cheeks, tanned a ruddy bronze; small bright dark eyes creased into half-moons by laughing; heavy straight brows; a short wide nose; a wide mouth with strong teeth; the eyes stay watchful and tired while the mouth laughs. Hair: black with a streak of iron grey at the left temple, pulled up into a thick knot at the crown, held by a flat bronze pin. Body: short, broad and stout, quick, shoulders square. Clothing: a bronze-brown wool robe of fine weave with a collar band of bronze thread; the sleeves pushed up above the elbows; a clay-grey leather apron with a scorched edge. Hands and objects: her bare forearms, mottled with pale glossy burn scars from wrist to elbow, one hand lifted open in the air; the three pendants of blue jade, each the length of a thumb, carved as slender drops, on a red cord. Background: the warm blurred orange of a furnace and a dark hanging bell-shape, out of focus. Light: strong warm light from the upper left, an orange glow from furnace fire on her right cheek. Expression: a big warm laugh, bright and a little hard, tiredness behind it.

people.imagined: Late evening on the casting floor, after the others have gone. He stands by the great flat-ringing bell in its pit and has just rested his palm on its rim, not striking it. He tilts his right ear toward it because the left ear is deaf. The clay colour of his face matches the clay floor.
people.subject: The moment: alone at dusk beside an enormous dull bronze bell, he rests one open palm on its rim and turns his head so the right ear is toward it, listening. Face: most important, his whole face and neck are the colour of dry red clay, plain and gaunt as a fired brick, and his left ear is a puckered, shrunken scrap of scarred flesh beside a closed ear hole. Hollow cheeks, a long jaw, a flat high forehead; deep-set small eyes of dull brown under straight heavy brows; a long thin nose; thin colourless lips pressed shut; very faint lines at the eyes. Hair: short black, cut close with a blunt edge, no ornament. Body: tall, gaunt, narrow-shouldered, stooped slightly. Clothing: a bronze-brown wool robe with plain round collar, sleeves pushed above the wrists, a clay-grey leather apron stiff with old clay; no pin, no cord. Hands and objects: his right hand flat on the curved green-brown rim of the huge bell, fingers spread, the skin of the hand the same clay colour; the bell fills the lower right of the frame, lip chipped. Background: a dark, blurred hall of hanging bells and the last orange of a banked furnace. Light: warm low light from the upper left, a dim orange glow below. Expression: quiet, still, absorbed, grief held without a flicker.

people.imagined: Dusk on the Cloud Bridge among the forty hanging bells. She has just raised her small hand bell and tilted her head, listening for the one that is wrong. On the new-moon nights she is not sure the answer comes from the wind.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk among rows of hanging bronze bells she holds a small hand bell by her ear and tilts her head to the left, listening. Face: a small, round, soft face with round shoulders under it; the head tipped sideways is the thing to read first. Fair brown skin with a few freckles, wide-set round dark eyes, slightly lowered, brows high and thin, a small nose, a small closed mouth that is about to speak; faint lines of listening across the forehead. Hair: dark brown with no grey, in a plain low bun at the nape pinned by a small bronze pin, a few loose wisps at the ear on the listening side, the ear bare. Body: small, round-shouldered, a little bent at the neck. Clothing: a bronze-brown wool robe with thin bronze thread at cuffs and hem, a plain collar, clean and neat; sleeves to the wrist. Hands and objects: in her raised right hand a hand bell no bigger than a plum, bronze, held by its cord, and a chip of blue jade drilled and hung beside it on the same cord, small and clearly blue. Background: blurred rows of larger bronze bells hanging against a dusk sky of violet and amber, thin rope lines. Light: soft amber light from the upper left, a faint glow on the jade. Expression: Head tilted, eyes unfocused and listening, lips just parted, and a small worried crease between the brows.

people.imagined: On the wharf in sea wind, morning. She holds the bell clapper in one fist like a club and a captain's book in the other, shouting down at a moored boat that its bell is a half tone flat. She is thinking of the boat she does not own.
people.subject: The moment: on a windy wharf in the morning she leans forward to shout at someone below the frame, a bronze bell clapper in one raised fist. Face: most important, a loud salt-tanned face, deeply weathered brown and creased, with white salt dried in the lines beside her eyes and a squint from looking at the sea. Wide jaw, strong chin, a broad nose peeling at the tip, a big mouth open in a shout showing a gap between the front teeth; thick black brows pulled down; dark eyes sharp. Hair: black streaked with grey, tied in a rough knot at the back with a faded blue rag, strands whipped across one cheek by wind. Body: strong, wide shoulders, forward-leaning. Clothing: a bronze-brown wool robe, well cut but salt-stained at the hem, a clay-grey leather apron, a cord of small bells looped over one shoulder; the sleeves rolled to the elbow showing brown forearms. Hands and objects: in her right fist a heavy bell clapper, a bronze ball on a short iron rod; in her left a thick book with a cloth cover held against her hip. Background: blurred grey-blue sea, a ship's mast and rigging, a gull. Light: bright cool daylight from the upper left, a salty haze. Expression: a challenge, loud and warm, the eyes already far away.

people.imagined: Afternoon, the mould shed. He is bent over a half-packed mould and has just looked up at someone who asked him to be gentler. His back is bent like a bell yoke, he pays no heed, and his nails are grey with clay.
people.subject: The moment: bent far forward over a clay mould at the bottom of the frame, he lifts only his eyes to the viewer, unhurried. Face: most important, the deeply bent back and bowed head make his shoulders rise nearly to his ears, and his hands and nails are packed with grey clay. A long, hollowed, leathery face the brown of old pottery, deep vertical grooves in the cheeks, a heavy brow, small narrow eyes of pale brown looking up from under the brow; a flat, thick nose; a thin, flat, unyielding mouth; a thin grey stubble. Hair: sparse iron grey, cropped short, a clay smear in it. Body: short, hunched, thick hands. Clothing: a bronze-brown wool robe, well fitted, grey with clay dust to the forearm; a clay-grey leather apron, creased and polished; a cloth tied over the forehead. Hands and objects: both hands, clay-grey to the wrist, pressed on a half-packed mould, a round shell of damp clay the size of a barrel; a wooden paddle laid on it. Background: a dim shed, blurred shelves of clay moulds, a shaft of dusty light. Light: warm light from the upper left, dust in the air. Expression: flat, patient and unmoved, hard in the eyes.

people.imagined: Wharf office at the lot-drawing. He holds the jar of berth pebbles up at shoulder height and has already felt for the white ones with his thumb. A captain stands in front of him. He rocks slightly on his heels, as if the floor still moved.
people.subject: The moment: at a wharf lot-drawing he holds a stoneware jar up at shoulder height with one hand, his thumb inside the neck, and looks at the viewer with polite blankness. Face: a narrow tanned face, flat across the cheekbones, with a long upper lip and a small, neat black moustache; eyes half closed with friendly sleepiness, pupils small and dark; a thin, straight nose; a faint smile on one side only, held a moment too long, which is the thing that should read. Hair: black, oiled, parted at the side and drawn back, a small plain bronze clasp at the nape. Body: lean, loose-shouldered, a slight sway as if on a deck, one hip dropped. Clothing: a bronze-brown wool robe of good weave, tidy, with the clay-grey apron folded over one arm; a narrow cord of tiny bells at the collar. Hands and objects: his right hand holds a brown stoneware jar with a narrow neck, small stones showing at the mouth, one white pebble pinched between thumb and forefinger; the left hand rests on a stack of papers bound with string. Background: blurred wharf planks, a ship's hull, rope. Light: grey morning light from the upper left, a soft sea haze. Expression: friendly, unreadable, a faint private smile.

people.imagined: A hot noon in midsummer on the caravan road. He wears the thick sheepskin coat and is complaining aloud to the cart driver about the heat, wiping his neck. Behind the complaint his eyes are counting the fittings in the cart.
people.subject: The moment: on a hot road at noon he has pulled a thick sheepskin coat open at the chest and is mopping his neck with a cloth, complaining, mouth in a grimace. Face: most important, a bulky sheepskin coat with curly cream wool at the collar and cuffs, far too warm for the sun. A wide, red, sweating face, sunburnt and shiny; a broad nose; round dark eyes with the lids lowered, a quick sideways glance; a short brown beard with a few grey hairs; a wide mouth open mid-grumble, showing a missing tooth. Hair: brown, shaggy, falling over the ears and sweaty at the forehead. Body: stocky, heavy-set, a loose stance. Clothing: the sheepskin coat, a bronze-brown wool robe under it with the collar open; a clay-grey apron rolled and tied at the belt; a cord of small bronze bells across his chest. Hands and objects: his right hand wipes his neck with a rag; his left holds a bronze bell the size of a fist by its loop. Background: a blurred dry road, a cart canvas, pale grass hills. Light: harsh bright sunlight from the upper left, deep shadow under the brow. Expression: loud and aggrieved on the surface, a shrewd sideways look underneath.

people.imagined: Night in the bell-keeper's shed above the Cloud Bridge. He lies awake fully dressed with his boots on, sitting up now, because the forty bells have begun answering something below. He listens. He has been told it is the wind.
people.subject: The moment: at night he sits bolt upright on a narrow bed with his boots still on, head turned toward a window, listening to something outside. Face: a thin, pale young face, the skin grey-white from sleeplessness with dark shadows under both eyes; wide-set eyes of dark brown, whites showing above the iris; thin straight eyebrows lifted; a pointed chin, a small mouth held tight; a day-old wisp of beard on the chin. Hair: black, uncombed, sticking up on one side from the pillow. Body: wiry, narrow shoulders, upright and tense. Clothing: a bronze-brown wool robe, dressed and belted though it is night, laced boots of brown leather with the cuffs showing at the bottom of the frame; a cord of two small bells at his belt, wrapped in cloth to keep them quiet. Hands and objects: both hands grip the edge of the plank bed; a stub of candle in a dish glows beside him. Background: a dark wooden shed wall, a small window with a deep blue night and the moonless sky, the dim shapes of hanging bells beyond. Light: a single candle from the lower left lights his face yellow, deep blue light from the window. Expression: alert, afraid and trying not to be.

people.imagined: Afternoon at the mould shed. She is carrying a full tray of moulds and her arms shake. A cough has just shaken her and she is holding it down so as not to drop the tray. She has coughed black since the third night.
people.subject: The moment: she carries a full clay-mould tray in both arms against her chest, and her arms visibly tremble as she holds in a cough. Face: a thin, pale girl's face with sunken cheeks and a smudge of dark grey around the nostrils and the corners of the lips; large dark eyes, red at the rims, brows drawn together with effort; a narrow nose; a small cracked mouth pressed shut; the neck thin. Hair: black, plaited in one short braid over the shoulder, clay in the strands. Body: frail, thin shoulders, bent a little under the load. Her collarbones show sharply above the neckline, her wrists are thin as reed stalks, and her knees seem to shake a little under the tray. Clothing: a bronze-brown wool robe, plain and clean but too big at the shoulders; the outer gate's clay dried grey to the elbow on both forearms; a clay-grey apron. Hands and objects: a wooden tray loaded with six round grey clay moulds, gripped with both thin arms, the knuckles white. Background: a dim shed with blurred shelves and a slot of afternoon sun. On the shelves behind her, blurred rows of grey half-packed moulds stand like stacked drums, and a rough ladder leans against the wall. Light: dusty warm light from the upper left. Fine dust floats in the slot of sun, giving her hair a pale grey halo. Expression: effortful and enduring, afraid to put it down.

people.imagined: Night at the pouring floor, alone. She has just stopped the pour of a bell and is holding the ladle, looking at the mould she is about to crack. Her knuckles are ground with red-gold dust, and her lip is bitten.
people.subject: The moment: at night she stands by a mould holding a long iron ladle with a spoonful of glowing metal still in it, her eyes fixed on a hairline crack just beginning in the clay. Face: a lean, hard-jawed face, sun-browned; a determined, slightly crooked mouth with the lower lip bitten; dark eyes narrowed in a stubborn glare; a thin scar through the left eyebrow; a faint sheen of sweat; the knuckles of the hand in the lower frame ground with fine red-gold dust, glinting. Hair: black, tied up in a high tight tail with a strip of scorched cloth. Body: strong, squared shoulders, short and wiry. Clothing: a bronze-brown wool robe, sleeves tied up above the elbow, clay-grey leather apron with a burnt hole near the hem; a leather glove on the left hand. Hands and objects: the right hand grips a long iron ladle; its bowl glows orange-yellow; the knuckles dusted red-gold. Background: dark floor, a big round clay mould half-sunk in sand, orange sparks. A rack of finished clay moulds stands at the left edge, and a bucket of cooling water gleams near her boot. Light: hot orange light from below and the right, rim light on the cheek. Sparks drift upward past her shoulder, each a tiny orange point. Expression: stubborn, defiant, a decision in the jaw.

people.imagined: Morning on the packing floor. She twirls the coil of wool cord at her wrist without noticing, still a shepherd. She flinches at the sound of the head's bell down the hall, the old guilt of running at the pit.
people.subject: The moment: at a packing table in the morning, she has stopped working and looks up toward a sound, with a coil of white wool cord round her left wrist turning in her fingers. Face: a round, wind-reddened country face with chapped cheeks; clear wide-set grey-green eyes; short stubby lashes; a snub nose with sunburn; a full mouth held slightly open; slight tension at the brow. Hair: light brown, in two short thick plaits tied with the same white wool. A few short strands escape the plaits and curl at the temples like unspun wool. Body: sturdy, short, strong forearms. Clothing: a bronze-brown wool robe, clean and neat, a little large; the outer gate's clay on the forearms to the elbow, dried pale; the clay-grey apron tied twice round. Hands and objects: the coil of undyed wool cord at her left wrist, three turns, with a loose end hanging; her right hand holds a wooden packing paddle with clay on it. Background: a blurred shed, a mould half packed, a window with grass hills. On the packing table behind her lie three small round moulds in a neat row and a bucket of grey slip. Light: soft daylight from the upper left. A narrow bar of morning light crosses her cheek and lights the pale clay on her forearms. Expression: a flinch of attention, sad and ashamed beneath.

people.imagined: In the shadow of the scrap pile at night. She has a lump of stolen scrap bronze in her hand and is checking behind her. The half-moon burn on her thumb is the first thing anyone would see.
people.subject: The moment: in the dark at the corner of a scrap pile she has just palmed a lump of bronze and looks over her shoulder with a stiff face, caught mid-glance. Face: a plain, square, freckled farm girl's face, full cheeks and a stubborn chin; narrow dark eyes under straight brows, sharp and guarded; a short wide nose; a thin mouth set shut in a line; a sheen of nerves on the upper lip. Hair: dark brown, cut blunt at the jaw, with a clay-coloured streak. Body: sturdy, stocky, squared shoulders. Her shoulders are rounded forward as she crouches, one knee on the ground and the elbow tucked tight to her ribs. Clothing: a bronze-brown wool robe, clean, with the clay-grey apron; clay dried on the forearms to the elbow. Hands and objects: in her right hand a lump of green-bronze scrap the size of an egg held close against her ribs; the thumb carries a clear half-moon burn scar, pink and glossy, held toward the viewer. Background: a dark pile of broken bronze pieces, blurred, with the night sky above. Dark heaps of green and brown broken bronze, a cracked bell mouth sticking out like a sleeping animal's ear. Light: a thin cool moonlight from the upper left, a point of orange from a far furnace. Expression: guarded and stubborn, ready to deny everything.

people.imagined: Midday on the casting floor. He leans a shoulder on a door and kicks it open without looking, carrying the great hammer, and grins at a bell he has not cast. He has a blister on every finger.
people.subject: The moment: at midday he shoves a heavy wooden door open with his shoulder, a great hammer slung on the other shoulder, grinning at someone off frame. Face: a broad, open, cheeky young face, tanned, with a wide mouth in an easy lopsided grin; a nose that was once broken and set slightly to the right; dark brown eyes bright and quick; a few stubble hairs on the chin; sweat shining at the temples. Hair: short black, spiky, cut with a knife. Body: broad, big forearms, a lean-forward weight. His chest is bare under the ripped-off sleeves at the shoulder joint, tanned and sweaty, and the leading boot is up on the door sill. Clothing: a bronze-brown wool robe, sleeves ripped off at the shoulder, a clay-grey apron with a scorch mark; leather wristbands. Hands and objects: the right hand around a long-handled iron hammer with a heavy head the size of two fists, resting on his shoulder; every finger of the left hand, held against the door, has a round white blister on its tip. Background: the bright doorway of a casting floor, glare, blurred bells. Light: strong sunlight from the upper left, a bright rim along the shoulder. A bright rim of white sunlight edges his hair and the hammer's head. Expression: easy and cocky, mischief in the eyes.

people.imagined: A busy afternoon at the Bell Wharf. She has just polished a small bell against her sleeve and is holding it up to sell. The gold hoop in her ear flashes when she turns. She says it was a gift.
people.subject: The moment: at the wharf in the afternoon she holds up a freshly polished little bronze bell for a buyer with a sweet, salesperson's smile and her head tilted. Face: most important, a gold hoop earring as big as a coin in her left ear, bright and catching the light. A round, pretty face, olive-tanned, with plump cheeks; bright, rather close-set dark eyes with a calculating glint; arched painted-looking brows; a small nose; full lips in a broad bright smile that does not move the eyes. Hair: glossy black, in a high knot with two loose curls at the ears and a red cord woven in. Body: plump and compact, a confident lean. Clothing: a bronze-brown wool robe, finely woven, with a bronze thread at the hem and a neat collar; the clay-grey apron over it, clean; a string of small bells on the belt. Hands and objects: a shining bronze hand bell the size of a lime held up between thumb and forefinger; the other hand cupped beneath it. Background: blurred sunlit wharf, bright water, masts. Light: bright sea-light from the upper left, a glint on the hoop. Expression: sweet, warm and smiling, her eyes a little too quick.

people.imagined: Twilight at a caravan halt. He sits on a cart rail with a spear across his knees, and scowls at the dark grass. The claw scar on his cheek tugs. He remembers the night the ward bell did not hold.
people.subject: The moment: at a caravan halt at twilight he stands watch on a cart, the shaft of a spear in his hand, frowning at the dark grass off frame. Face: most important, four parallel pale claw scars run down the left cheek from the eye to the jaw, ridged and bright against the tan, and pull the cheek when he frowns. A long, rawboned face, a strong jaw, short dark stubble; dark eyes narrowed, watchful; a straight nose; a firm mouth, the corner dragged down by the scar. Hair: short, black, dusty from the road. Body: tall, rangy, a warrior's easy readiness. His weight rests on the left leg while the right foot is set on the cart's rim, and the spear leans so close that his fingers touch it without looking. Clothing: a bronze-brown wool robe, plain and clean, a dust-coloured leather jerkin over it, a clay-grey apron folded in his belt; a small bell wrapped in cloth at the collar. Hands and objects: a plain iron-headed spear held upright against his shoulder, the blade catching the last light. Background: a blurred wagon canvas and a darkening steppe sky, a faint line of pale grass. A line of carts with greasy canvas covers and a thin smoke from a cooking fire to one side. Light: the last gold light from the upper left, deep shadow on the scarred cheek. Expression: wary, alert, set hard.

people.imagined: Bright morning before the tuning. He spins a bell clapper between his fingers, bored, unable to sit still, rocking on his heels with a grin. The tide comes through the rock arch at his home twice a day, and he cannot wait for either.
people.subject: The moment: on a bright morning he flips a small bronze clapper between his fingers as he bounces on his toes, grinning straight at the viewer, bored and unable to keep still. Face: a long, lively, sun-brown face with a big grin showing a chipped front tooth; light brown eyes with laughing creases, always on the move; a snub nose; thin, mobile brows raised high; pointed ears, the left slightly higher than the right and carrying a small bronze ring that is too large for it. Hair: tousled sandy-brown, falling in his eyes, tied up by a bit of string on top. Body: thin and restless, shoulders forward, long in the leg and short in the body, so that his bounce makes his whole frame sway like a reed. Clothing: a bronze-brown wool robe with the sleeves pushed up over forearms dusted with the pale clay of the outer gate; a clay-grey apron tied slightly askew; the inner robe a darker bronze-brown with a loop of red thread knotted round the left wrist. Hands and objects: a small bronze clapper, a ball on a stem, tumbling between the first and second fingers of the right hand, caught in blur; a cord of tiny bells hangs at the belt. Background: blurred, a row of unlit casting furnaces under a lean-to, bright wharf stairs beyond, a white sky and a gull. Light: bright morning light from the upper left, with a clean white sky behind. Expression: restless and gleeful, a lazily mischievous grin that never quite settles.

people.imagined: Late afternoon on the Cloud Bridge, sun on her face. She blinks slowly like a cat, bell mallet loose in her hand, and might doze where she stands. She sleeps through the new-moon ringing and is the only one who does.
people.subject: The moment: in late afternoon sun she stands with a mallet hanging loosely from one hand, eyes half closed, blinking slowly, utterly relaxed. Face: a soft, calm, rounded face with fair, sun-warmed skin; heavy-lidded, almond-shaped dark eyes half shut; faint smile lines; a small straight nose; full relaxed lips with a faint upturn; a trace of sleepiness. A small crease at the corner of each closed eye shows where she smiles in her sleep, and her lashes are long and dark against her cheek. Hair: black, in a loose long braid over one shoulder, a small bronze bell tied on its end. Body: soft-built, slow, slouched at ease. Her shoulders hang low and loose and her weight leans on one hip, as if she might fold down onto the bridge planks at any moment. Clothing: a bronze-brown wool robe, neat and loose, with the collar slightly open; a clay-grey apron; sleeves to the wrist. Hands and objects: a felt-headed wooden bell mallet hanging from her right hand; the left hand lightly resting on a bronze bell that glows in the sun. Background: blurred bells in a row against a warm gold sky and bridge ropes. Behind her the Cloud Bridge's rope rails run off in perspective, hung with forty round bronze bells, and a flock of small birds crosses a pale gold sky. Light: warm gold afternoon light from the upper left, lighting the eyelids. Expression: sleepy, serene, content, as a cat in the sun.

people.imagined: Beside the furnace, face lit orange. He pumps the great bellows with a cheerful grin; the heat has eaten his eyebrows. He is happy to be useful and has no idea he is the best fire on the floor.
people.subject: The moment: at a furnace he hauls on a long bellows handle, his face lit orange, smiling broadly with the effort, happy to be useful. Face: most important, he has no eyebrows at all, only a smooth shiny brow with a few singed stubs, which makes the round face look permanently surprised. It is a round, ruddy, sweating boy's face with large, bright, light-brown eyes, a stub nose, a wide open smile, and soot smudges on both cheeks. Hair: short and black, singed at the front into an uneven edge; two stiff little tufts are all that is left of his fringe, brown at the tips where the heat took them. Body: slight and thin-armed, wiry from work. Clothing: a clean bronze-brown wool jerkin, sleeveless, so his thin arms are bare to the shoulder; over it a clay-grey leather apron larger than he is, scorched at the hem by a long burn from the furnace and tied with a double string at the back to stop it trailing. This is practical wear of the trade. Hands and objects: both hands wrapped round the wooden handle of a big leather bellows, knuckles pink with heat; a wet cloth is wound round his left wrist to guard against sparks. Background: a roaring furnace mouth, white-orange, with sparks, blurred; at the right edge a second furnace glows dull red, and a stack of split charcoal rises against the dark wall. Light: strong orange firelight from the right and below, with a rim of light on the cheek. Expression: cheerful and absorbed, delighted by the work, the grin wide and unselfconscious.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the man at the moment of his defining act: the winter of 1121, at the lip of the pit, calm, one jade pendant in hand, about to order the pour of the great bell. He believed the best bell is never struck.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, of a man standing calmly at the lip of a casting pit in winter, a single carved jade pendant held at chest height. Face: a long, mild, thoughtful face, fine-boned, pale brown; calm, patient eyes of soft brown with a deep, kind look; a straight nose; a gentle closed mouth with a faint trace of a smile; a short trimmed beard, black with a few silver hairs; the lines of a craftsman who squints at small work. Hair: black with grey at the temples, tied up in a plain knot with a bronze pin. Body: slender, upright, soft-shouldered. Clothing: a bronze-brown wool robe with bronze thread at the collar and cuffs, a clay-grey leather apron; a plain winter wrap of coarse wool over the shoulders. Hands and objects: a single blue-green jade pendant carved as a drop, held up by its red cord between the finger and thumb of the right hand; the other hand tucked in his sleeve. Background: a wash of pale grey, the faint outline of a huge bell and cold mist. Light: faint, even and pale, as if from old silk. Expression: calm, gentle, and certain.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the ship-bell ringer on the deck of Lận Viễn Phàm's first boat in 1158, wind in her face, one hand on the ship's bell, ready to ring it past the edge of the charts.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, of a woman on a ship's deck in a high wind, one hand on a bell, her chin lifted toward the horizon. Face: a brave, bright, slightly freckled face, windburnt pink on the cheeks; wide, clear eyes of light brown squinting at distance; a quick open mouth in a half smile; a straight small nose; stray hair whipped across one cheek. Hair: dark brown, tied back in a long tail that streams sideways in the wind, a bronze bell tied at its end. Body: slim, sturdy, braced at the rail. Clothing: a bronze-brown wool robe, belted and kilted up for deck work, a sea-grey scarf round the neck, clay-grey apron laid aside; sleeves tight at the wrists. Hands and objects: her right hand on a small bronze ship's bell hanging from a post, the rope in her fist; her left holds the rail. A coil of tarred rope lies over her left forearm, and her fingernails are cut short and square from rope work. Background: a faded pale grey-blue sky and sea, a sail edge, no land. Far behind her the faded mast of the ship leans against a thin grey line where sea meets sky, with a single seabird. Light: soft, faint, even light, as if from old silk. Expression: Bright, eager eyes fixed on the horizon, chin high, a half-smile that is bold and a little reckless.
